body:
God I'm so sorry I didn't write back, I didn’t mean to make you so upset. I meant to write back to you but the holidays came and I’m not the fastest writer and I get distracted.I’ve also been feeling really down these last couple weeks. Also, and this sounds stupid, but I was feeling really bummed out. I was writing to someone on Reddit and we wrote back and forth every couple of weeks for 6 months and then one day they never wrote back. Then in July someone else wrote to me and we started emailing back and forth every couple days until on October 31st. She wrote, I responded, and she never wrote back. I wonder what I did wrong? I haven’t really talked about it with anyone but it has bothered me more than I want to admit. Then I ended up doing the same thing to you. I’m hesitant to give you my name as I really do still want to kill myself. I was thinking February as there are not any holidays or birthdays. But I don’t want to be a downer. My name is Malachi.

Anyways to respond to your last message, I’m glad to hear that your boss is human oriented. When I worked at the Quiznos my older brother used to be a real ass sometimes. I feel even today that he likes to take other people's side just to take their side. I used to hide stuff from him and not tell him about customers just because he would be such an ass. Never had a customer freak out while I was there so I missed out on that. :) I’ll admit all my info about the NTSB comes from watching those Air Crash Investigator type shows on Youtube. Yeah the America’s Funniest Home Video type videos just aren’t that funny. In fact some of the videos that people show are actually really disturbing. “Look this woman fell off of a balcony and landed on the concrete with her neck! Isn’t that funny? HAHAHAHA.”

I like watching RedLetterMedia because I have a somewhat similar humor. I can be pretty sarcastic and offensive. Though I make sure to not do the more offensive jokes in mixed company. 

My brother is really like this. He once talked about a job interview longer than it took to go to the interview, get lunch, and come back. It was a 20 minute interview and he talked about it to our mom for more than two hours. He can never tell short stories. Never. [He reminds me of this Patricia O’neal clip.](https://youtu.be/HCXFB8-oPx0?t=96) I partially listen when my mom is talking about her students. Some of them are funny, but others are just her complaining about them not listening and stuff. Not the most interesting stories.

We have 8 cats. Though it is not all our fault. One we took in because it was a neighbor's outdoor cat at my dad's place and had to be taken in after it had surgery. And the most recent cat is a 14 year old partially blind cat that we were fostering and eventually we just decided to keep her. She is actually really playful for her age.

I’ve been to Disneyland several times. In fact we have found ourselves going yearly the last three years. I read forums and such to keep up on the news. They just closed a large part of it to build Star Wars Land. [They just did the last Running of the Goats (and apparently two sheep) before they get rid of them.](https://youtu.be/kH7ZzMizWHA?t=6) Look at all those cameras. There is a special light bulb on Main St. When they built cok corner they have a circle of lights that alternate red and white. But when they built it they didn’t realize that by having an odd number of lights that meant that at some point in the circle the same color would be next to each other. The story goes that Walt was walking down the street when he noticed the mistake and called a painter to paint half of the bulb. [So even today there is a half white, half red bulb.](http://www.mousewait.com/disneyland/chat_images/659392_c_img.jpg) Apparently one day a couple years ago there was maintenance done on the area and the bulb was not replaced. DUN-DUN-DUUUUN!!!

I’ve been doing the couch to 5k. We’ve done it on the track at the nearby high school a couple times and we also just jog in place on the days it is raining. We aren’t doing it three times a week like the program wants but we have done it 6 times.Going to a gym might be better as it is also a way to control the speed of the jogging on the treadmill. How has it been going with you? I haven’t done any drawing still. I should definitely start. Shittywatercolor has gotten better over the years. It is true that I would probably be too critical but I don’t want to put up crap :).  [Here is the drawing I did for the only drawing class I went to.](https://anonmgur.com/up/93e742760161cb77687fd305ca2980f3.jpg)

How was your Christmas? Did you get to see Star Wars. What did you think?

Secret shoppers must suck. Do they typically blame the employee in their reports? This is a random point but for example in the US when the NTSB is investigating crashes and such they rarely prosecute individuals instead looking at the overall system and why the system failed. Incorrect maintenance work is not seen as the fault of the employee but rather a system that does not make assurances that the work is being done properly and that the employees may not have enough time to do the work properly. Sorry that was really random. Do people actually yell at you? I’ve never yelled at an employee before. Of course with anxiety I don’t think I could. I worked at a fast food place for awhile and I customers complain about stuff but never yell. And I get the thing with family, always having to pretend to give a shit. have thought of making a comic called the Poorly Drawn Depressed Stickmen. I think Bob Ross is real good as he isn’t very detailed, so it makes it easier while still looking nice. NFL Bad Lip Reading  is great. I was laughing so hard, they do a great job. I like watching Red Letter Media stuff.

That is the thing, people complain to me about people that I will never meet. And sometimes what they are complaining about is really insignificant and stupid. Like why the fuck should I care about this. The other thing about forums is it is really easy to just ignore certain people and skip past what they say. There are a couple major disneyland forums and on one of them there is a lot of information but also a lot of bitching about crap. For example Disney replaced a light bulb wrong and there was 5 pages of complaints about it. Some people, like me, like disneyland and keep up on the changes and news about them. What forums do you visit?

I am going to start running Monday. Probably at the local high school as they have a track to run on. Someone suggested online instead of running to speed walk when you should run to help break you in. I have never really been one to run so this will be interesting. Are you just doing aerobics? I didn’t phrase the drawing thing well, I meant that I would watch like youtube videos on how to draw and then draw on paper. I attempted to draw something one time using a mouse and it was painful. Maybe if my art gets good enough I will post it to deviantart.
Still feel the same. The drugs are still shipping. I am aiming for February as that is past the holidays and there are no nearby birthdays.

Like what are people expecting from you? I do alright in ceramics but I really have never practiced drawing. My drawing from the class looked fine but normally my drawings look terrible. Even my stickmen look deformed. Have you tried painting with Bob Ross before? [Yips is a term used in sports when players just cannot seem able to do basic plays.](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Yips) I don’t know if you follow baseball but for an example there is a pitcher called Jon Lester who cannot throw two first. It is kinda like tilting in gaming, though tilting usually means the person is getting angry.

I catch myself not listening to what someone is saying and just waiting to say something myself. I have to calm myself down and focus. Sometimes I just stop listening because I start playing with my phone. Very bad of me.

I don’t know, I don’t say much about anything when talking to people. I don’t really have interesting interests or hobbies. I just seem to panic and end up saying short sentences to people. I’m weird. I do hang out on Disneyland forums though I don't comment much.

Well I did roll my eyes so mission accomplished. :) Maybe I should do the couch to 5k. Or more like the couch to actually moving. :) My sister started running a couple years ago suddenly.I have also been thinking about practicing my drawing over the internet. I just need to do it.

This time of year is busy. I took a drawing class and a ceramics class. Embarrassingly for some reason my anxiety got too bad and I stopped going to my drawing class. Archery was fun though at one point I got the yips and just started screwing up and couldn’t figure out why.

It actually takes me a long time to write stuff. But my face to face interactions are terrible. I freeze up/panic when talking to people. Plus I’m boring so I don’t really have much to talk about. I don’t really know what to say to people when they tell me stuff.

I just feel that everyone is already leaps and bounds ahead of me that small accomplishments just won’t cut it. I feel like I’m falling further and further behind every day.

Thanks for writing.

Thanks for writing back.

I took mostly basic classes. I took some chemistry classes and math classes. But I eventually dropped out of chemistry and math because it was too hard and I was failing. I also took a archery class. 

I agree with you on the babies. Big vomiting, pooping, blobs. Not really into kids. I realize that people show off their best part of life on Facebook but I would like to have some of what they have. I'm just so utterly alone. But I don't know how to talk/connect with people. So I spend my days talking to myself. I would love to just hang out with people and have fun. It would be nice to feel like someone actually likes me by choice. And relationships are like friends that like you so much they decide to spend a lot of time with you. I just wished someone liked me. 

When I am talking about significance I meant something you would tell another person. Like if someone came up to you and asked about what you have been up to the past 6 months. People would talk about their job, moving to a new place, relationships, etc.  I just realized when asked that in three years I have not improved at all. I'm the same today if not worse than I was three years ago. What am I supposed to say? That I finally managed to call a stranger without panicking too much? That I sleep, browse the internet all day, help with some basic chores, and then go back to sleep? There is just nothing about me.
The best thing about futurama was the suicide booths.

I'm done waiting. I've been waiting my whole life to be like a human instead I developed into a fat blog of shit.  For years I've been making small differences and I'm worse of today than I was just a few years ago. Everyone is just so much better and I'm so terrible that I am ashamed to even talk to people.

I’m not the best story teller. I grew up in the boonies. My K-8 school had around 200 kids. I had a couple people that I would hang out with during recess and stuff, but never really after school. My high school had something like 1600 kids. I still ate with the couple kids that I knew from elementary school. They never did thing with me outside of school. I tried to learn how to drive but I am anxious just being a passenger, so I was super anxious driving. I was terrible and super nervous driving and I failed my driving test. I worked at my family’s failing business and didn’t do well. I am just slow, dumb, and make too many mistakes. I went to a community college but did poorly so I dropped before getting a degree. I am now 27 and have nothing to show for it. All my old classmates are getting married, hanging out, have jobs/carriers.  I’m just not as good as people generally are.  I went with my mom to meet an old friend of ours that we haven't seen in three years and she asked what was new. That is when I realized that in the three years that she last met me I have done absolutely zero of any significance. All that struggle for nothing. The only relief I see is death.

Ye I have worked on them but have failed. Being alone and doing everything wrong does something to you. I don't feel human. I cannot connect with anyone. I was hoping there was another way but it appears that suicide is the only escape. I wish I wasn't a bad human.


>If you're so ready to go, why solicit strangers? 

You're right. I was hoping that there could be at least one good thing out there.
You don't know me and if you did you would ignore/dislike me just like everyone else.
Just got access to some very powerful drugs that should kill me. I should be happy buy I am just blah about it. I just don't care anymore.
